newsitem.title: POLAND: Japanese firms mull upping investment in Poland.
newsitem.headline: Japanese firms mull upping investment in Poland.

text.p: Representatives of some of Japan's largest industrial corporations are considering increasing investment in Poland, the president of Japan's Chamber of Industry and Trade said on Tuesday.

"We want to conduct frank negotiations aimed at expanding cooperation between our countries," Kosaku Inaba told a meeting of Polish businessmen and more than 60 officials from more than 20 Japanese firms.
By the end of the first quarter this year Japanese investment in Poland was at $33 million, only about 0.4 percent of all foreign investment in Poland.
Poland's Panstwowa Agencja Inwestycji Zagranicznych (PAIZ) foreign investment agency puts Japan in twenty-second place among foreign investors in Poland.
